endorsements.quote: When curating diagnostics based on clinical utility, it is important to first prioritize clinical unmet needs based on their ability to be addressed with a digital solution.
Performance within any given use case must be considered with respect to the prevailing gold standard imaging modality, the diagnostic standard of care, and the unmet needs to be addressed.

For hospitals or health systems considering adopting a digital diagnostic, pilot trials can aid in considering how clinical utility of digital diagnostics may apply within their specific populations and workflows.

unlisted_practices: Evaluate the economic impact of adopting a digital diagnostic, including cost savings, downstream procedure effects, and reimbursement, before adoption.
Consult health technology assessment organizations and guideline bodies for third-party perspectives on the evidence for a digital diagnostic.
Scale the level of evidence required for a digital diagnostic to the disease burden, allowing lower evidence levels with trial-basis evaluation in high-burden conditions.

screen.reason: This is a brief report/commentary proposing guiding themes and a structured approach for healthcare providers to evaluate the clinical utility of radiology AI tools.
